discrepancies.title: origin key format inconsistent across model families
discrepancies.original_assumption: origin is a directly joinable key across all models
discrepancies.corrected: Stage 8.1 uses integer origin index (1-173); Stage 8.17A/8.19 use full ISO datetime strings; foundation models and Stage 3C/4.3 use YYYY-MM-DD date strings
discrepancies.resolution: derived canonical `date` key from timestamp column for all models; verified identical ground-truth actual values across all 10 models at matched (date, horizon) pairs (cross-model std ~9e-6)
discrepancies.severity: would silently break any naive cross-model join

discrepancies.title: bulk timestamp parsing fails without format='mixed'
discrepancies.original_assumption: timestamp column uniformly parseable with a single to_datetime call
discrepancies.corrected: mixed offset formats (+00:00 vs trailing Z) cause NaT for 9 of 10 models unless format='mixed' specified
discrepancies.resolution: used format='mixed' and verified zero NaT after fix

discrepancies.title: foundation-model 'Full 347 origins' label does not match actual origin count
discrepancies.original_assumption: Chronos/TimesFM/Moirai/Persistence evaluated on the official 347-origin benchmark set
discrepancies.corrected: these five models actually contain 365 unique origins (full calendar year); Stage 3C/4.3 correctly contain 347
discrepancies.resolution: restricted all models to the 173 verified ODD dates before any cross-model comparison in Phase 3-5
discrepancies.severity: aggregate metrics in POLARIS_MODEL_COMPARISON_MATRIX.csv for these five models are not apples-to-apples with the ODD champion figure without this restriction
